examShortTricks: Trick 1: Human sex determination: XX female, XY male; the father's sperm (X or Y) decides the sex — 50:50; state 'male is heterogametic'.
Trick 2: Haemophilia pedigree: affected father X^hY passes to ALL daughters (carriers) and NO sons; carrier mother × normal father → 50% sons affected — the two standard crosses.
Trick 3: Colour blindness is X-linked recessive; females need BOTH X's affected — hence males (hemizygous) suffer far more.
Trick 4: Other disorders for the list: sickle-cell anaemia (autosomal recessive, HbS), Down syndrome (trisomy 21), Turner (XO), Klinefelter (XXY).
